This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat and Rice Bowls are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. If eaten, they will replenish several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Composed of rice and lightly seared [[Meat]], these dishes are considered a mainstay throughout [[Hyrule]]. Additional [[Ingredient]]s can be used when making Meat and Rice Bowls, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. * '''Electro Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. These bowls completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. When eaten, they refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Eating these Meals will temporarily increase Link's speed. * '''Hearty Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. If eaten, Link's [[Stealth]] will be temporarily increased. * '''Spicy Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]] if he eats these dishes. * '''Tough Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This dish of rice and lightly seared meat is a mainstay all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. They will increase Link's [[Defense]] when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cheesy Meat Bowl * Food * Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl * Meal * Prime Meat and Rice Bowl }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
